summary: Retest of 3 previously failing bugs from iteration_2. All 3 fixes verified PASSING on preview URL with admin@mg-vms.com login. Topbar theme toggle now toggles between dark/light (document.documentElement.classList and localStorage.mg_theme update correctly). Settings page theme/language buttons all work. Cameras snapshot now opens a shadcn Dialog (role=dialog) with snapshot image. Login flow no longer emits navigate-during-render warnings.

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent (Radix a11y warning; non-blocking but should add DialogDescription or aria-describedby for accessibility)
Hydration warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' originating from translation render in <option> at Cameras.jsx:53. Non-blocking but pollutes console.

action_items: (Low) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to snapshot Dialog to silence Radix a11y warning
(Low) Wrap translation text in <option> as plain string (avoid nested span from t() rendering) on Cameras.jsx line 53 to fix hydration warning
critical_code_review_comments: AppContext.toggleTheme/toggleLang still use closure-based setState (setTheme(theme==='dark'?'light':'dark')). Works currently because component re-renders, but if ever called twice in same render frame it would lose updates. Safe today; consider functional updater later (and dropping StrictMode double-invocation pitfall by guarding logic).
Cameras snapshot mock uses real Unsplash image; acceptable since snapshot is documented as MOCKED.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_3 confirmed 3 retested bugs are fixed. Remaining nits are non-blocking (a11y dialog warning + hydration <span> in <option>). Backend not retested in this iteration as request was frontend-only.
rca of the issue: Previous iteration_2 failures were caused by: (1) functional updater inside toggleTheme being double-invoked under React.StrictMode causing net no-op; (2) setTheme not being exported from AppContext, so Settings buttons could not update theme; (3) snapshot displayed without role=dialog. All three resolved in iteration_3 verification.
